name: engineering-kit
description: Engineering skills for AI coding agents. /engineer understands, diagnoses and fixes difficult codebases with evidence: what a change would reach, what the Git history shows, and before-and-after runs in throwaway copies. /database investigates PostgreSQL read-only with bounded queries and reconciles disputed figures to an exact bridge. Also vetted, pinned skills for bug diagnosis, test-first work, architecture scans, plan interviews, retros, primary-source research and setup wizards. Every command runs only when you call it, unless you choose at install to let /engineer and /database start on their own.
